A screensaver for GNOME, adapted from the Chrome extension [ASCII Animals New Tab](https://github.com/Pawan-webdeveloper/Ascii-Animals-extension) by Pawan-webdeveloper.

**Installation** (Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04): download the `.deb` file below, open a terminal in the folder that contains it, and run the following command:

```bash
sudo apt install ./ascii-animals-screensaver_*_all.deb
```

Then launch **ASCII Animals Screensaver** from the applications menu to enable the screensaver.
